# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest published SDK version receives security updates.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Use this repository's **Security** tab
and select **Report a vulnerability** to send details privately to the maintainers.

Include the affected SDK version, impact, reproduction steps, and any suggested mitigation. The
maintainers will acknowledge the report and coordinate disclosure through the private advisory.
